method: randomized actions against lib/core.mjs with a simulated clock: grants, buys/sells/cancels, purchases/approvals/refunds, deposits/redemptions, loans/repayments, out-of-order and batched daily closes, maintenance, parent rolls and manual closes
runs: 30 seeds x 1,500 steps (about 2 simulated months); 12 seeds x 4,000 steps reaching 2027-08 to 2028-05, which exercises quote pruning
invariantsAfterEveryStep: cash equals the sum of ledger deltas and is never negative
stock reservation equals the budgets of pending buys; available cash never negative
each position's shares, cost and every sell's realized P&L equal a chronological replay of its fills
public views render for both roles
drain: after delivering every final close and settling, no order with a closed target date stays pending
